lines.zh: 我一跳一跳，背心跟着抖。
lines.en: Hop by hop, my vest bounces with me.

lines.zh: 前爪沾了露水，走起来凉。
lines.en: My forepaws are wet with dew; it's cool going.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子探路，耳朵转个不停。
lines.en: I scout with my nose, ears turning constantly.

lines.zh: 这背心有点紧，但很精神。
lines.en: The vest is a bit tight, but I look sharp.

lines.zh: 草丛比我还高，我钻过去。
lines.en: The grass is taller than me; I slip through.
Two hops, then I stop and listen.

lines.zh: 平原太空旷了，我贴着边走。
lines.en: The plain is too open; I keep to the edge.
One kick of my hind legs covers ground.

lines.zh: 露水沾在背心上，有点沉。
lines.en: Dew on my vest makes it heavier.

lines.zh: 我一路蹦着，边跳边看天。
lines.en: I bounce along, glancing at the sky.

lines.zh: 这一片草好吃，我记住了。
lines.en: Good grass here. I'll remember it.

lines.zh: 我跳得轻，不留什么脚印。
lines.en: I hop lightly, barely leaving prints.

lines.zh: 有风吹草动，我就停一下。
lines.en: Any stir in the grass and I freeze.

lines.zh: 耳朵竖起来，能听见很远。
lines.en: Ears up, I can hear a long way.
I'm not going anywhere. Just wandering.

lines.zh: 前面有块石头，我跳上去看。
lines.en: A rock ahead; I hop up to look.

lines.zh: 我蹲在草地上，背心铺平了。
lines.en: I crouch in the grass and my vest lies flat.

lines.zh: 耳朵转来转去，停不下来。
lines.en: My ears swivel and won't hold still.

lines.zh: 我在想，这背心是谁给的。
lines.en: I wonder who gave me this vest.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我鼻子就开始动。
lines.en: When the wind blows, my nose starts working.

lines.zh: 这身打扮，在平原上有点显眼。
lines.en: Dressed like this, I stand out on the plain.
I wash my face with my forepaws.

lines.zh: 草叶上一个洞，是虫子咬的。
lines.en: A hole in a blade of grass — something chewed it.

lines.zh: 我坐在后腿上，像个看门的。
lines.en: I sit up on my haunches like a gatekeeper.
Good sun; I narrow my eyes.

lines.zh: 没事发生，我就理理背心。
lines.en: Nothing happening, so I tidy my vest.

lines.zh: 我在听远处的声音，很细。
lines.en: I'm listening to something far off, very faint.

lines.zh: 这一片没什么敌人，挺好。
lines.en: No enemies around here. Good.

lines.zh: 我打了个呵欠，牙齿露出来。
lines.en: I yawn and my teeth show.
The wind pushes my ears back.

lines.zh: 我挪了挪屁股，找了个好位置。
lines.en: I shift my rump to a better spot.

lines.zh: 有时只是想坐着，不发呆。
lines.en: Sometimes I just sit without thinking.
I look up at you, ears pinned back.
First I check whether you're moving.
One step from you and I hop back.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，鼻子抽了抽。
lines.en: I look up at you, nose twitching.

lines.zh: 你身上没有野兽的味道。
lines.en: You don't smell of a predator.
Doesn't the vest suit me?

lines.zh: 我偏过头，想看清你的手。
lines.en: I tilt my head to see your hands.

lines.zh: 你要蹲下来，我才敢靠近。
lines.en: Crouch down and I might come closer.

lines.zh: 平原上很少有你这么高的东西。
lines.en: Few things this tall on the plain.

lines.zh: 我耳朵对着你，随时要跑。
lines.en: My ears point at you, ready to bolt.
You smiled? Then it's fine.

lines.zh: 我穿着背心，是只体面的兔子。
lines.en: I wear a vest. A respectable rabbit.
I squeal and leap away.
Why hit me? I'm so small.
My vest is torn.

lines.zh: 我缩进背心里，屏住呼吸。
lines.en: I curl into my vest and hold my breath.
My leg's sore, but I can still hop.
I can't catch my breath; I slip into the grass.
Stop it; I'm not fighting back.
You pulled my vest crooked.
My hind leg gives and I can't hop.
I'm shaking too hard to stand.
Carrots! I saw orange.
I won't snatch; I'll wait for it to drop.

lines.zh: 这个味道，我耳朵都软了。
lines.en: That smell makes my ears go soft.
Two hops closer, then I stop.
Hold still and I'll come myself.
One bite and it's wonderfully crisp.
I eat and keep looking around.

lines.zh: 这么好的东西，留着慢慢吃。
lines.en: Something this good, I'll eat slowly.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子贴上去，先闻个够。
lines.en: I press my nose to it and sniff my fill.
I'm a messy eater. Don't mind.

lines.zh: 再给我一根，我就跟你走。
lines.en: One more and I'll follow you.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，跑到草丛里去。
lines.en: I take it and dash into the grass.
This beats wild grass by far.
I hold it in both forepaws so it won't fall.
When it's gone, I lick my lips.
Got more? I'm still hungry.
One bump and I bounce far off.
I'm so light a touch sends me flying.
Sorry, I hopped off course.
I land on all four feet at once.
I shake the dirt off my vest.
Your feet are too big to dodge.
That gave me a fright.
I go around your legs.

lines.zh: 撞完我先看看背心有没有破。
lines.en: Afterward I check the vest for tears.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，从你身上越过。
lines.en: I hop up and over you.

lines.zh: 我用后腿跺地，咚咚两下。
lines.en: I drum the ground twice with my hind feet.

lines.zh: 远处也有回音，一样的节奏。
lines.en: An answer comes, the same rhythm.

lines.zh: 我们绕着圈跳，谁也不碰谁。
lines.en: We hop in circles, never touching.
I raise my ears for it to see.
Two rabbits, one leaping higher.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子凑过去，碰了一下。
lines.en: I bring my nose over and touch.

lines.zh: 这背心是它先看上我的。
lines.en: The vest was what drew it to me.

lines.zh: 草被我们踩平了一小片。
lines.en: We've flattened a small patch of grass.
Still daylight. We take our time.
It hops away, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我叼起一片叶子，嚼了嚼。
lines.en: I pick up a leaf and chew it.

lines.zh: 这东西太硬，我吐了出来。
lines.en: Too hard. I spit it out.
I hold it in my forepaws and tilt my head.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，都能吃吗？
lines.en: Is everything on the ground edible?

lines.zh: 我把它塞进背心的口袋里。
lines.en: I stuff it into my vest pocket.
Not bad — another bite.
A stone. I thought it was food.

lines.zh: 我叼着它跳了两步，掉了。
lines.en: I carry it two hops and drop it.
A small piece — enough to gnaw on.
I sit and gnaw it slowly.

lines.zh: 有东西在看我，我僵住了。
lines.en: Something's watching me. I freeze.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵压平，缩成一团。
lines.en: I flatten my ears and curl up.
I'll run first. No fighting.
My hind legs are already coiled.
Against a build like yours, I'm outmatched.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚，看哪只先抬。
lines.en: I watch your feet for which one lifts first.
The grass is tall. Maybe I can hide.
I thump the ground to warn you.
I don't bite unless cornered.

lines.zh: 这背心今天恐怕要脏了。
lines.en: The vest will get dirty today, I fear.

lines.zh: 我一直看着你，不敢眨眼。
lines.en: I keep watching you, afraid to blink.
You take a step; I give one back.
I edge toward the taller grass.

lines.zh: 耳朵一直朝着你的方向。
lines.en: My ears stay pointed your way.
I hold, waiting for a chance.

lines.zh: 你的影子伸过来，我往后退。
lines.en: Your shadow reaches me and I shrink back.
The grass is tall; I listen with both ears up.

lines.zh: 心跳太快，我压着不敢动。
lines.en: My heart's too fast; I hold still.
When you turn your head, I run.
I'll stare until you lose interest.
I swipe with a forepaw, quick.
Bite and run — I don't linger.
A kick from my hind legs stings.
I didn't want to bite; you grabbed first.

lines.zh: 这一撞用上了整个身子。
lines.en: I throw my whole small body into it.
One hit and I hop away.
Small teeth, shallow bite.
I'm panting; not much strength left.

lines.zh: 这一下，是我最后的力气。
lines.en: That was my last effort.
Only once you're gone do I dare stop.

lines.zh: 我从草丛里钻出来，背心先探头。
lines.en: I pop out of the grass, vest first.

lines.zh: 平原上多了一只穿背心的兔子。
lines.en: One more vested rabbit on the plain.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖耳朵，确认方向。
lines.en: I shake my ears to get my bearings.
The grass here is a bit taller than me.
I hop twice to test my legs.
Nice breeze; I squint.

lines.zh: 我把背心理正了才出门。
lines.en: I straightened my vest before coming out.

lines.zh: 平原上没动静，我先啃两口。
lines.en: The plains are quiet; I nibble a little.
A bite first, then think about the rest.
My ears twitch. It's quiet here.

lines.zh: 背心着火了，我到处乱跳。
lines.en: My vest is on fire; I bounce about wildly.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，摔懵了。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope, dazed.

lines.zh: 水比我高，我挣扎着往下。
lines.en: The water's over my head; I thrash and sink.

lines.zh: 炸得我飞出去，耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The blast throws me and my ears ring.
Something's stuck in my back. It hurts.

lines.zh: 奇怪的光缠着我，毛都竖了。
lines.en: Strange light wraps me and my fur stands up.

lines.zh: 草都枯了，我肚子贴到背。
lines.en: The grass withered; my belly's against my spine.
Lightning strikes and my fur is singed.
My vest catches the wind as I keep falling.
